full_management_of_user_environment_vari.description: Use `true` to manage all user environment variables. (Default: false)

token.description: Token to authenticate on tsuru API (optional)

default_router.description: Default router at creation of app

cpu_average.description: CPU average, for example: 20%, mean that we trigger autoscale when the average of CPU Usage of units is 20%.

custom_address.description: Custom Prometheus URL. If not specified, it will use the default Prometheus from the app's pool

name.description: Name of the Prometheus autoscale rule

prometheus_address.description: Custom Prometheus URL. If not specified, it will use the default Prometheus from the app's pool

query.description: Prometheus query to be used in the autoscale rule

threshold.description: Threshold value to trigger the autoscaler

percentage.description: Percentage of units to scale down

units.description: Number of units to scale down

block.description: Behavior of the auto scale down
List of schedules that determine scheduled up/downscales

new_version.description: Creates a new version for the current deployment while preserving existing versions

output_image.description: Image generated after success of deploy

override_old_versions.description: Force replace all deployed versions by this new deploy

status.description: after apply may be three kinds of statuses: running or failed or finished

wait.description: Wait for the rollout of deploy

block.description: Perform an application deploy. Currently, only supporting deploys via prebuilt container images; in order to deploy via tsuru platforms please use tsuru-client

team.description: Teams to grant access to the app

certificate.description: Certificate Generated by Issuer, filled after the certificate is ready

router.description: Routers that are using the certificate

block.description: Set a issuer to generate certificates to a tsuru application

addresses.description: List of addresses to tsuru API connect in

ca_cert.description: CA certificate to connect in cluster, must be enconded in base64

client_cert.description: Client certificate to connect in cluster, must be enconded in base64

client_key.description: Client key to connect in cluster, must be enconded in base64

default.description: Whether true, the cluster is the default for all pools

initial_pools.description: Name of initial pools, required when is no default cluster

local.description: Whether true, the cluster is auth by the local credentials of kubernetes

pools.description: Name of pools that belongs to the cluster

block.description: Resource used to assign pools into clusters

active_deadline_seconds.description: Time a Job can run before its terminated. Defaults is 3600

schedule.description: Cron-like schedule for when the job should be triggered (keep empty for manual jobs)

output_image.description: Image generated after success of deploy

status.description: After apply may be three kinds of statuses: running or failed or finished

wait.description: Wait for the rollout of deploy

block.description: Perform an job deploy. Currently, only supporting deploys via prebuilt container images; in order to deploy via tsuru platforms please use tsuru-client

default.description: Factor of burst, ie: 1.1 means 10% of burst

max_allowed.description: max allowed when user customizes the burst

pool_expr.description: The name of pools, allow glob match style

config.description: Configuration for router in YAML format

readiness_gates.description: List of readiness gates associated with this router

encoding.description: Encoding format used to communicate with the service API backend. Valid options are "form" (default) and "json".

endpoint.description: Single service endpoint URL. The server stores it as endpoints["production"]. Mutually exclusive with "endpoints".

endpoints.description: Map of endpoint name to URL, e.g. { production = "https://prod..." }. Mutually exclusive with "endpoint".

unbind_on_delete.description: Unbind service instance from apps on delete (default = true)

wait_for_up_status.description: Wait for instance to reach up state

expires.description: Token expiration with suffix (s for seconds, m for minutos, h for hours, ...) 0 or unset means it never expires

regenerate_on_update.description: Setting regenerate will change de value of the token, invalidating the previous value

team.description: The team name responsible for this token

token_id.description: Token name, must be a unique identifier, if empty it will be generated automatically
